 James Harden Off Cleveland Cavaliers Injury Report For Chicago Bulls, Evan Mobley Ruled Out Again
 Evan Mobley is out for Monday against Chicago, while James Harden, Donovan Mitchell, and Jarrett Allen are off Cleveland's injury report and Peyton Watson is questionable.
 JR By Jake Rogers Published November 15, 2026 at 5:14 pm EST 2 min read ☆ Add us as a preferred source on Google See more of our reporting in your Google results.
 Share This Story Copy Link Email Story ↗ Story Link Orlando Magic forward Franz Wagner (No. 22) drives to the basket between Cleveland Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell (No. 45) and guard James Harden (No. 1) during the first quarter at Rocket Arena in Cleveland on Oct. 11, 2026. (Ken Blaze-Imagn Images) In this article Evan Mobley Set To Miss Third Straight Game 
 Watson Moves To A New Listing 
 CLEVELAND — Evan Mobley has been ruled out for the Cleveland Cavaliers ‘ game Monday against the Chicago Bulls with a left great toe sprain, while James Harden , Donovan Mitchell , and Jarrett Allen are off the NBA’s 4:30 p.m. ET injury report Sunday after all five Cleveland starters sat out Saturday.
 Peyton Watson is questionable for Monday with right abdominal soreness. He was ruled out Saturday with right hamstring injury management, the same night Harden (left lower leg/calf tightness), Mitchell (left knee contusion/injury management), and Allen (right knee injury management) missed the 127-117 win over the Dallas Mavericks .
 Evan Mobley Set To Miss Third Straight Game
 Mobley sprained the toe late in Wednesday’s 115-107 win over the New York Knicks , and Cleveland.com reported that an MRI came back clean. Monday will be his third straight absence.
 Cavaliers coach Kenny Atkinson called the injury a sprain after Saturday’s win and offered a rough sense of how far along Mobley was.
 “He looks better already,” Atkinson said . “He’s not on the court yet, but this isn’t a month or something like that.”
 Watson Moves To A New Listing
 Watson missed two games earlier this month with right hamstring soreness and has started all 11 games he has played this season.
 Jaylon Tyson is also questionable with right ankle injury management. Sam Merrill is out with right elbow injury management, and Nae’Qwan Tomlin is out with a low back stress reaction.
 Tip-off is set for 6 p.m. CT at Rocket Arena.
